topics.title: Effective writing and the purpose of note-making

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the abilities a student needs to write effectively, such as coherence, cohesive devices and command of grammar.
Explain why note-making is an important study skill useful at study and at work.

topics.title: Reading for main points: underlining and questioning

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the important information in a passage by underlining it.
Frame and answer questions while reading to pick out the main points of a passage.
Write points in note form using phrases, colons and long dashes without full verb forms.
Distinguish between the letter/figure system and the decimal system of dividing notes.
Use abbreviations and symbols and omit articles, prepositions and conjunctions in notes.
Evaluate whether a set of notes is short, logical and meaningful when read again.

topics.title: Practice: making notes on the formation of coal and petroleum

concepts.learning_objective: Convert verb-based statements into noun-headed note points.
Combine and group related points from a passage into ordered notes.
